
==Syntax==
Same as [[Template:Random]], except that it produces a random number from 1 (inclusive) to max (inclusive)

==Examples==

{| class="wikitable"
| Code
| Result
|-
| <nowiki>{{random1}}</nowiki>
|         {{random1}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random1|1000}}</nowiki>
|         {{random1|1000}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random1|1000|872322935}}</nowiki>
|         {{random1|1000|872322935}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random1|1000|872322935|13}}</nowiki>
|         {{random1|1000|872322935|13}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random1|1}}</nowiki>
|         {{random1|1}}
|-
|}
